camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public ListColumns --region cn-hangzhou --TableId 'maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name' --Order Asc --IncludeExtendedProperties true --Comment test_comment --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy Position --Name test_table
description_en: Queries the column list of a specified table in DataWorks Data Map
description_zh: 查询数据地图给定数据表的字段列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-columns --table-id maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name --name test_table --comment test_comment --sort-by Position --order Asc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --include-extended-properties true --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListColumns

parameters.help_en: The table ID. You can obtain the ID from the response of the ListTables operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据表ID，可参考ListTables接口返回结果，
以及https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2880092.html
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en: The name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The comment. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. Default value: Position. Valid values:
Name: name.
Position: position
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认为Position，枚举值，当前支持
Name 名称
Position 位置
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. Default value: Asc. Valid values:
Asc: ascending order.
Desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向，默认为Asc，枚举值，当前支持
Asc 升序
Desc 降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认为10，最大为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return extended properties. Set this parameter to `true` to return extended properties or `false` to not return them
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回扩展属性。设置为 `true` 时返回扩展属性，设置为 `false` 时不返回
parameters.name: include_extended_properties
